morning.headline: US Futures Rebound as Risk-On Tone Dominates Pre-Market
morning.summary: US index futures are showing a strong rebound this morning, with the S&P 500 and Nasdaq 100 futures trading higher, following a risk-on sentiment overnight. This follows a significant down day for US equities yesterday, with SPY and QQQ both closing down over 1.5% and 2% respectively. The VIX saw a notable increase yesterday but is trading lower in pre-market action. Key levels to watch on SPY and QQQ are their 20-day support and resistance. Dealers are net short gamma on both SPY and QQQ, suggesting they may amplify market moves.

highlights.label: Futures Firm
highlights.text: US index futures are up, with S&P 500 futures +0.63% and Nasdaq 100 futures +1.08%, indicating a positive open after yesterday's sell-off.

highlights.label: Overnight Risk-On
highlights.text: Global markets showed a risk-on tone overnight, with notable strength in South Korean and Japanese tech stocks, alongside Bitcoin, while natural gas declined.

highlights.label: Short Gamma
highlights.text: Dealers are net short gamma on both SPY (-$8.1B) and QQQ (-$3.2B), with current spot prices below their respective gamma flip levels, potentially amplifying volatility.

highlights.label: SPY Levels
highlights.text: Watch SPY support at 722.59 and resistance at 760.4, with the current price at 725.43.

highlights.label: QQQ Levels
highlights.text: QQQ support is at 686.37 and resistance at 748.65, with the current price at 693.69.

highlights.label: Notable Flow
highlights.text: TSLA call buyers are active on expiring contracts, while SMH put buyers are aggressive on near-term expirations and AAPL put buyers are targeting out-of-the-money strikes.
